purpose: Bind LinkedIn native-export post measurement to the exact FCR platform, account, post, and experiment identity while preserving the boundary that caller-declared identity is not provider authentication and missing/capped export evidence is never a zero-performance claim.

claims: scripts/linkedin_analytics_continuity.py must bind targeted native-export observations to an exact canonical LinkedIn post plus declared FCR account and experiment identities, must withhold learning eligibility until provider-authenticated account binding and sufficient exact-post metrics exist, and must never promote capped-export absence or date-level ENGAGEMENT totals into exact-post zero/failure or engagement claims.

scripts/test_linkedin_analytics_continuity.py must reject false greens for capped-export absence, daily aggregate engagement leakage, malformed or spoof-shaped identity input, and any receipt that would grant learning, publication, or strategy-mutation authority from caller-declared identity alone.

docs/founder-signal-engine/linkedin-analytics-continuity.md must state that exact-post native visibility and exact-post impressions are observation evidence only, caller-declared account identity cannot authenticate provider ownership, unavailable exact-post engagement remains null, and missing visible post evidence remains UNKNOWN_NO_EVIDENCE rather than zero or failure.
